title: Alibaba Releases New Speech Recognition Model, Medical Vocabulary Accuracy Exceeds 95%, Holds the Lowest Error Rate Globally

content_html:
Alibaba officially released the large-scale speech recognition model Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR-Flash, with a clear core goal—enabling AI to accurately understand specialized terminology. The model has made systematic optimizations in three dimensions: context consistency, industry-specific word recognition, and hot word customization. It also has voice polishing capabilities, allowing it to directly output structured text.

The research team has continuously mined professional vocabulary from fields such as healthcare, IT programming, stock markets, and social celebrities, building a high-quality vocabulary database covering multiple industries. In the latest internal evaluation of industry-specific terms, the new model showed significant improvements in "listening accuracy" across various industries, with medical scenarios reaching 95.36%.

Three versions cover five scenarios, and it has already taken the global top position

The Qwen-Audio-ASR-Flash series has been verified in scenarios such as meeting note organization, real-time subtitles, educational recording, and intelligent customer service. Previously, it achieved the number one ranking globally on the AI evaluation platform Artificial Analysis with an error rate of 1.7%. This means that the accuracy of AI speech-to-text in real office and educational environments has reached the ceiling of usability.

The model is now available for access through the Alibaba Cloud BaiLian platform, offering three versions: the Flash version for real-time speech recognition up to 5 minutes, the Filetrans version for offline file transcription, and the Streaming version for real-time speech recognition. When AI not only "can listen," but also understands those complicated technical terms in your industry, the last mile of voice interaction may soon be solved.

content_html_zh:
阿里巴巴正式发布大规模语音识别模型Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR-Flash，核心目标明确——让AI能够准确理解专业术语。 该模型在上下文一致性、行业词识别、热词定制三个维度上进行了系统优化。 它还具有语音润色功能，可以直接输出结构化文本。

研究团队不断挖掘医疗保健、IT编程、股市、社会名人等领域的专业词汇，构建了覆盖多个行业的高质量词汇数据库。 在最新的行业术语内部评估中，新模型在各行业的“听力准确率”方面均表现出显着提升，其中医疗场景达到了95.36%。

三个版本覆盖五种场景，已稳居全球第一

Qwen-Audio-ASR-Flash系列产品已在会议笔记整理、实时字幕、教育录音、智能客服等场景得到验证。 此前，它在人工智能评测平台Artificial Analysis上以1.7%的错误率获得全球第一。 这意味着AI语音转文字在真实办公、教育环境中的准确率已经达到了可用性的天花板。

该模型现已在阿里云百联平台开放，提供三个版本：用于长达5分钟实时语音识别的Flash版本、用于离线文件转录的Filetrans版本以及用于实时语音识别的Streaming版本。 当AI不仅“会听”，还能理解行业中那些复杂的技术术语时，语音交互的最后一公里可能很快就会得到解决。
